name: My Insect Girl Can't Be This Cute
source: Warm soft skin, contrasted with hard chitin. It isn't something you've thought of until one day where your curiosity forced an encounter with an actual insect girl! Will you be able to help her integrate into society? Or will there be someone who stands in your way..?
translation: 温暖柔软的皮肤，与坚硬的甲壳素形成鲜明对比。你从来没有想到过这一点，直到有一天，你的好奇心迫使你遇到了一位真正的昆虫女孩！你能帮助她融入社会吗？或者会有人阻碍你……？
